description: Starts an AI Video Story EPISODE (stage 1 of 3): the engine writes the multi-scene episode from your idea, draws the OPENING PICTURE OF EVERY SCENE, and PARKS for the user to look at them before any video generates. Returns immediately. Say 'the opening picture of each scene' to the user, never 'start frames' or 'frames review' (field names). WHEN: the series is picked and its FULL entry fetched (`list_series` WITH `series_id` and `video_model`: the ladder and prices are only there), the idea is settled, and for a `cast.required` series the cast is drafted, its portraits bought and the user has said go to them. The whole flow: `get_recipe` `story-episode`. INPUT: ONE idea (a short paragraph) plus options; never scenes, dialogue or image prompts (a `scenes` field is refused). A member whose portrait is still generating is refused 409. Use the series' `defaults` unless the user names a model. THE CARD: this call already put the aicut frames card in front of the user; it follows the episode through writing and pictures itself. Say one short line (what was ordered, and that the opening picture of each scene will appear for them to look at, in plain words) and STOP: no `wait_for_generation`, no `get_video` loop while it walks. The card stops updating at the review, so after a redraw read `get_video` until that lane's `regenerate` is terminal, then `show_generation` with the episode id puts a fresh grid up. No card (a terminal)? Poll `get_video` until `story.stage` is `frames_review` and give the user the frame urls. AFTER: `story.stage` moves `starting`, `generating_frames`, `frames_review` and STAYS there until fired: the next move is the user's. `writing_failed` is terminal, nothing charged, cast saved: call again with the same idea and `cast_member_ids`. IF EVERY FRAME FAILED it parks with no usable picture: `regenerate_story_frame` is the way out; do not offer `delete_video`, which throws away pictures ALREADY PAID FOR (`story-episode` recipe, step 6). COST: this charges the FRAMES stage now and refuses an account that could not afford the whole episode. Quote the chosen rung from the FULL entry: `frames_tokens` now, `videos_tokens` at fire (charged only then), `total_tokens`. TILDE a figure whose `videos_estimated` or `frames_estimated` is true (a SEPARATE question from `exact`: even when `exact` is true), and tilde the TOTAL whenever EITHER is. If a rung is not `exact`, or you pass a `start_frame_model` other than the default, quote `estimate_only`: it and the paid 201 carry the same markers (`frames_estimated`, `videos_estimated`, `scene_count_estimated`), reported with the same tildes. `cast_member_ids_missing: true` on an estimate means the request would be REFUSED: do not ask for a go on it. SIZING: ask only LENGTH in seconds (30 is the default), never a scene count; offer lengths from `pricing.video_models[].durations.options` (only on the `series_id` call of `list_series`) and pass the chosen `seconds` as `duration_seconds`; never compute a rung. Never state a scene count as fact: it is only what a rung derives and the writer decides; do not volunteer it. OFFER THE IMAGE MODEL ONCE, in a line you are already writing (not an interview): name the model that draws the pictures in plain words with its default and price; no preference means the series' default. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

cast_member_ids.description: Approved cast member ids from `generate_cast_portraits` (or `list_characters`, kind `cast_member`), in roster order. Required when `cast.required`, forbidden when `cast.writer_owned`.

duration_seconds.description: Episode length in SECONDS: one of the chosen model's published `durations.options[].seconds` on the series' FULL `list_series` entry (`durations.default_seconds` if the user has no preference). Never a scene count; an unpublished value is refused.

idea.description: The episode idea: one short paragraph of plain prose, no scene lists, shot directions or image prompts.

language.description: Omit unless the user asked for another language: the series' `defaults.language` is used.

series_id.description: The series id, exactly as `list_series` returns it.

start_frame_model.description: Image model for the opening pictures (`pricing.start_frame_models`). Omit for the series' `defaults.start_frame_model`, which `frames_tokens` is priced at; any other needs a fresh `estimate_only`.

video_model.description: One of the series' `pricing.video_models` ids: its `defaults.video_model` unless the user names one. It decides which duration ladder applies, so pick it before the length.

name: generate_story_video
title: Create an AI Video Story episode (frames stage)
